ls -la

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, collections
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
print("bytes",len(data))
print("has CR", b'\r' in data, "has tab", b'\t' in data, "has quote", b'"' in data)
lines=data.split(b'\n')
print("last line empty?", lines[-1]==b'')
print("num lines", len(lines)-1)
# counts of commas per line
cc=collections.Counter(l.count(b',') for l in lines if l)
print("comma counts", cc.most_common(10))
# charset
chars=collections.Counter(data)
print("non-ascii", [(bytes([c]),n) for c,n in chars.items() if c>127][:10])
# leading/trailing whitespace stats
ws=collections.Counter()
for l in lines:
    if not l: continue
    s=l
    ws[('lead', s[:1] in b' \t')]+=1
    ws[('trail', s[-1:] in b' \t')]+=1
print(ws)
# sample random lines
import random
random.seed(1)
for l in random.sample([x for x in lines if x],8):
    print(repr(l))
PY

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,re
bad=0
pat=re.compile(rb'^ *([A-Za-z]+[0-9]+) *$')
firsts=collections.Counter()
with open('input.csv','rb') as fi, open('expected.csv','rb') as fe:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(fi,fe)):
        a=a.rstrip(b'\n'); b=b.rstrip(b'\n')
        parts=[p.strip() for p in a.split(b',')]
        pred=b';'.join(p.upper() for p in parts[::-1])+b';OK'
        if pred!=b:
            bad+=1
            if bad<5: print(i,repr(a),repr(b),repr(pred))
        for p in parts:
            if not pat.match(p):
                firsts[p[:30]]+=1
        if i>200000: break
print("bad",bad)
print("odd fields sample",list(firsts.items())[:10], "count",sum(firsts.values()))
PY

cd /workspace
runbench() {
  name="$1"; script="$2"
  cp input.orig.csv bench.csv
  printf '%s\n' "$script" > /tmp/b.vim
  s=$(date +%s%N)
  vim -Nu NONE -n -Es bench.csv -S /tmp/b.vim
  rc=$?
  e=$(date +%s%N)
  echo "$name rc=$rc elapsed=$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms  first=$(head -1 bench.csv)"
}
runbench gUU "call setreg('b', \"gUU\")
%normal! @b
wq"
runbench AOK-esc "call setreg('c', \"A;OK\\<Esc>\")
%normal! @c
wq"
runbench s-dollar "call setreg('c', \":s/\$/;OK/\\r\")
%normal! @c
wq"
runbench noop-x "call setreg('c', \"x\")
%normal! @c
wq"

cd /workspace
